accountId.description: The account the query was run against.

queryState.description: Server state string for this query result.

canCalculateChanges.description: Whether the server can calculate query changes.

position.description: Zero-based index of the first result in ids.

ids.description: The Thread ids in the requested window.

total.description: Total number of results (if calculateTotal was true).

limit.description: The limit applied to this query.
